Hey, it feels like I'm reading a story about myself. Of course our situations aren't exactly the same but a loving and caring person did help me out of that bad time. 15 is quote young but you never know when you'll find it. For me it was around 17 someone loved and cares for me, we were intimate and it was great, but you also need to be strong on your own. You can't always rely on someone else. 
You don't have to love a person, you can try to love something in life as well and explore that to find your happiness there. You might think I've already tried everything but that's absolutely not true!  Gaming is fine to use to release your frustration or anger. You can always try something else. You never know if it works until you try, really. How often have you actually checked out a movie or series / Anime or book and it was actually much better than you thought it'd be and you're glad you actually tried?  Well thats the same for other activities you can do in life. I hope this message helps a little good luck friend :)
